title: Hazel and the Alibi
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Beatrix Dravenmoor, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
